text:
hana: Hi everyone 3 day 1 on Platform. Trying to spin up a tiny dev GKE cluster in asia-south1 (Mumbai) for a local demo but hitting two separate blockers: static IP allocation fails with quota, and I can't create a project service account for our CI runner (permission denied). Who's the right person to ask for IP quota bumps vs IAM permissions?

omar: welcome Hana! For quotas ping infra-oncall (they auto-file requests). For IAM, depends: if it's a project-level SA we usually handle it in infra, org-level changes go via SRE/security. What exact errors are you seeing?

hana: static IP error: "Quota 'IN_USE_ADDRESSES' exceeded for region asia-south1" when trying to reserve an external static ip with `gcloud compute addresses create hana-dev-ip --region=asia-south1`. For SA: `gcloud iam service-accounts create ci-runner-sa` returns "Permission 'iam.serviceAccounts.create' denied on resource project/my-dev-sandbox".

ryan: infra-oncall-bot can open the quota ticket. @infra-oncall-bot can you request +8 IN_USE_ADDRESSES for asia-south1 for project=my-dev-sandbox requester=hana?

infra-oncall-bot: quota-request received: project=my-dev-sandbox region=asia-south1 quota=IN_USE_ADDRESSES requested_increase=8 requester=hana ticket=2005006789-Q. ETA: 1-2 business days for review. If this is blocking a demo today, tag `urgent` and SRE can temporary-allocate from dev IP pool.

hana: demo is tomorrow so 1-2 days would be okay, but would prefer not to change regions. If we need temporary IPs, what's the process to borrow from dev pool?

omar: ping me and I can do a short-term borrow for dev demos (we ask to return when done). Usually we annotate the IP with a label and set TTL 72h. For long term infra uses we file the quota.

hana: thanks. On the IAM side: I need a service account for the GitHub Actions runner to create node pools and pull images from Artifact Registry. I want to avoid long-lived keys. What should I request?

ryan: recommended pattern: Workload Identity + a short-lived federated credential for GH Actions, or use GCP Workload Identity Federation. If you still need an SA, request: roles/container.nodeServiceAccount (or a narrower custom role for node pool ops), roles/artifactregistry.reader, and roles/compute.networkUser only for the specific VPC/subnet. Avoid roles/container.admin unless absolutely required.

hana: aha, we use GH Actions. Can infra help set up WIF or do I need permissions to create the SA + provider?

omar: infra can set up the workload identity provider, but you need iam.serviceAccounts.create in the project to create the SA (or ask infra to create it and grant the runner the actAs binding). If you prefer, open a request with the exact bindings and we will create the SA and provider on your behalf.

hana: I'll do that. Proposed bindings: [roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser on the GH provider principal, roles/artifactregistry.reader on my-dev-sandbox, roles/compute.networkUser scoped to the cluster VPC]. Is that too broad?

ryan: looks good. We may replace compute.networkUser with roles/compute.networkUser limited to the subnet via a custom role. Also confirm whether the runner needs to create firewall rules or only attach node pools.

hana: only attaching node pools and pulling images. No firewall changes.

omar: perfect. I'll create a ticket to provision the SA + WIF provider and grant the scoped roles. Tagging SRE to speed up the IP if you want a short-term dev IP.

sre: we can loan one external IP from the dev pool for up to 72h for demos. @omar please DM me the project and intended TTL. Also Hana, note that asia-south1 has fewer preemptible quotas; if you need cheaper nodes, consider asia-south2 fallback. We'll document preferred APAC fallbacks in onboarding.

hana: thanks all 2 I'll file the SA/WIF request with exact principals and also try the quota request. If infra can pre-create the SA that would save me time. Will report back after infra PR/response.

omar: one more FYI: you do not need AWS org access for this GKE demo. The AWS org invite is for teams operating in AWS. We still onboard people into SSO but access won't be required unless you touch S3/KMS.

hana: good to know. Closing loop later: demo is scheduled tomorrow afternoon; if I hit blockers I will ping @omar and @sre. Thanks everyone :smile:
